name: regkv
description: Read a Windows registry hive with regipy: a key's values (each with its registry type and length, read whole: regipy's default cut to 256 characters is not taken), its subkeys with their last-written times (raw FILETIME and ISO 8601 UTC with seven fractional digits), and a bounded recursive listing. A reader, not a decoder: a binary value comes back as hex and nothing more, so UserAssist, ShimCache, BAM, SAM and ShellBag values are not decoded here. Completeness is said: unreadable keys and values are under problems, branches the walk did not enter (depth or node limit, or an error) under stopped_branches, and the whole recursive listing is kept in a file the answer names past the inline page; status is complete or partial (partial when a problem was named, a branch was not entered or the inline listing was cut). Every key listed is also in a file the answer names (all_subkeys) when the inline list of 2,000 is not the whole of it. depth is 0 to 128; a key whose subkey list was already reached (a cycle, or a list two keys share) is named and not entered again; a key that declares more values than were read is a problem; a hive that is not a regular file (a named pipe) is not opened. hive_dirty (the two sequence numbers differ) and the transaction logs beside the hive are reported; the logs are NOT replayed, so a dirty hive's newest state may be missing. SENSITIVE: values whose name says password, secret, token or credential (a DWORD or QWORD excepted), every value under Policy\Secrets, PolEKList and PolSecretEncryptionKey of a SECURITY hive, the cached logons (NL$) and the V value of each SAM user are replaced by a marker holding only their length and listed under sensitive_values_withheld; the type of a value never lets one through, and the place is judged by the key names the hive holds, not by the spelling asked for. No flag brings one back. A secret inside a value that does not look like one (a command line with a password in it, an ImagePath) is NOT recognised and comes back whole. The key path is read from the hive's root, a leading backslash or not.

hive.description: Path to the registry hive file on disk (a copy; transaction logs beside it are named, not applied)

key.description: Registry key path, backslash form e.g. \Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion

depth.description: Levels below the key to open when recurse=true (default 2); a branch left closed is listed under stopped_branches

limit.description: Recursive nodes shown inline (default 500, an inline page size); the whole listing is in the file named by all_nodes

max_nodes.description: Upper bound on the nodes a recursive walk visits (default 1000000); branches left past it are listed under stopped_branches
